summary: Shows installing a collection from a local tarball with ansible-galaxy collection install and -p, recommending a path in COLLECTIONS_PATHS; without -p the first COLLECTIONS_PATHS entry is used.
questions: How do I install a collection from a tar.gz file?
Where does ansible-galaxy install a collection if I don't give -p?

answer_card.title: Install a collection from a tarball
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install my_namespace-my_collection-1.0.0.tar.gz -p ./collections
```
Install into a directory in `COLLECTIONS_PATHS` so Ansible finds it. Without `-p`, it goes into the **first** `COLLECTIONS_PATHS` entry.
